description: The slash commands this bot's application has registered. Omit guild for the global set, or pass a guild for that server's set. Guild commands and global commands are separate lists; a name can exist in both.

bot.description: Which bot to act as, by name, when more than one is configured. Omit to use the default bot.

guild.description: Guild (server) name or ID. Omit to use the default guild.

title: List app commands
